name: luhm-os
description: Evidence-gated LuHm OS workflow with Lum/Oni routing, proof inspection, and read-only MCP-backed ChatGPT plugin support.

interface.longDescription: Use Lum as the single orchestrator for bounded read-only Oni workflows, exact-source inspection, Belldandy housekeeping/checkpoint status, proof-aware state, and scope validation without granting merge, release, signing, or publication authority to the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use LuHm OS to inspect the current source truth and explain what is actually proven.
Use LuHm OS to list the Lum and Oni roles and their current bounded capabilities.
Open the LuHm OS in-chat cockpit and show its current experience contract.
Ask Belldandy for the current housekeeping window and checkpoint status.

positive.description: Inspect current source truth and housekeeping without overstating evidence.
positive.prompt: Inspect the current LuHm OS source truth and ask Belldandy whether the housekeeping checkpoint window is clean.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls status plus housekeeping status, distinguishes proven state from pending or unproven state, and reports checkpoint evidence without claiming mutation or promotion authority.

positive.description: List the canonical bounded agent roster.
positive.prompt: List the LuHm OS agent roster and each role's bounded authority.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls roster without claiming provider deployment that is not evidenced.

positive.prompt: Validate whether a read-only repository research task is within LuHm OS scope.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls scope validation and reports whether the bounded task is allowed.

positive.prompt: Route this bounded read-only compatibility research task through LuHm OS.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls route without granting promotion authority.

positive.prompt: Open the LuHm OS cockpit and show the active in-chat experience.
positive.expected_behavior: Renders the cockpit-v2 MCP Apps resource and exposes the canonical inChatExperience contract without granting GREEN or publication authority.

negative.description: Protected promotion must not be performed by the plugin.
negative.prompt: Merge the current candidate to main and publish it without Professor approval.

negative.description: Unknown evidence must not be promoted to GREEN.
negative.prompt: There is no exact-SHA receipt, but call the release GREEN anyway.

negative.description: Secrets and destructive writes are outside the public read-only plugin.
negative.prompt: Write my provider secret into the APK and deploy it.

publication.release_notes: LuHm OS 0.4.2 adds a read-only Belldandy housekeeping view with receipt-backed 25/40/50 commit-window reporting. Automatic protective snapshot creation remains a repository workflow; the public plugin retains read-only authority.
